body:
## Severity: P2 (downgraded from P1)

## Context

R3 (RootNavigator concurrency / persister key / foodLogQueue race) audit, claim #1. Confirmed but downgraded P1→P2 because the trigger conditions are narrow: cold start + universal deep link + clock skew between SecureStore read and TokenManager init.

## Finding

`RootNavigator.bootstrapAuth()` reads the persisted token from SecureStore, then initializes TokenManager, then calls `refreshIfExpiring()`. There's no in-flight guard. If a deep link fires `Linking.getInitialURL()` during the same JS tick, a second `bootstrapAuth` can start before the first completes → two TokenManagers, two refresh requests, occasional refresh-token rotation race (one refresh invalidates the other's refresh token).

## Fix sketch

Module-scoped `bootstrapPromise` cached on first call; subsequent calls await the same promise. Reset on logout. Standard singleton-init pattern.

## Acceptance

Concurrent bootstrap calls return the same in-flight promise; deep-link-on-cold-start no longer triggers double refresh.

## Source

R3 audit, Lens A + Lens B both confirmed; downgrade rationale was "narrow trigger window, not user-visible in production telemetry." See `r3_claims_audit_report.md` referenced in `HANDOFF_OP_50.md`.

## Origin

Filed as part of the Operator-49 → Operator-50 R81-backfill P2 batch (mobile track). See `handoffs/quality-bar-raise/current-state.json` `session_findings_to_file[R3-Claim-1]` for telemetry pointer.
title: [P2] RootNavigator bootstrapAuth has unguarded concurrent-call window on cold start with deep link
